title: Total DNA Midi CTAB Prep for Zymoseptoria tritici
author: Bruce Mcdonald
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.s2wegfe

steps.title: Culture and Harvest Spores
steps.instruction: Grow a single spore isolate in 40-50mL YSB for 5-8 days at room temperature in a shaker at 120-160rpm.

substeps.instruction: Harvest spores by centrifuging in a 50mL Falcon tube at approx. 3500rpm for 10-15min.
Pour off supernatant.
If not using immediately, transfer tissue to a 5 ml Falcon tube or leave in 50 ml Falcon tube, spin in centrifuge at full speed to pack tissue, and store at -80 degrees Celcius.
Lyophilize tissue on lyophilizer overnight or until completely dry.

steps.title: Prepare CTAB Extraction Buffer
steps.instruction: Prepare 100 ml of CTAB extraction buffer using the following components: 14.0 ml 5 M NaCl (700 mM), 5.0 ml 1.0 M Tris (pH 8.0) (50 mM), 2.0 ml 0.5 M EDTA (10 mM), 10.0 ml 10% CTAB (1 %), 1.0 ml B Mercapto EtOH (1 %), and 68.0 ml Distilled water.

substeps.instruction: Note: 10% CTAB stock is good for six months at 4 C.
Note: Fresh batch of CTAB extraction buffer must be made each day as it expires after 48 hours.

steps.title: Tissue Grinding and Initial Extraction
steps.instruction: Grind tissue into a fine powder and add CTAB extraction buffer.

substeps.instruction: Place tissue in mortar and add liquid nitrogen (only if tissue is wet) and grind with pestle; alternatively, grind lyophilized tissue with a glass rod directly in tube.
Transfer powder to a 15 ml centrifuge tube (filling no more than 1/2 of the tube).
Immediately add 5 ml CTAB extraction buffer (wear gloves as buffer is caustic).
Mix well by agitating and inverting the tube several times.

steps.title: Incubation
steps.instruction: Place tube in 60oC H2O bath for 45-60 min, agitating the tube every 10-15 minutes.

steps.title: Chloroform Extraction
steps.instruction: Perform chloroform extraction in a fume hood to minimize exposure to vapors.

substeps.instruction: Add 5 ml chloroform:isoamyl alcohol (24:1, v:v) and emulsify by gently inverting for 10-15 seconds.
Centrifuge at 10,000 rpm (12,900 X g) for 15min to produce three layers.
Transfer the upper aqueous phase to a fresh 15 ml tube.
Repeat the chloroform extraction process once more.
Add an equal volume of isopropanol to the 15 ml tube.
Gently invert the tube 15-20 times.
Let the tube sit at room temperature for 10 minutes.
Centrifuge at 9,000 rpm for 6 min.

steps.title: First DNA Wash
steps.instruction: Wash the DNA pellet using ammonium acetate and ethanol.

substeps.instruction: Pour off supernatant and let the pellet drain well on paper towels.
Resuspend pellet in 2.0 ml TE.
Precipitate DNA by adding 0.5 volume (1.0 ml) 7.5 M NH4OAc and 2 volumes (4.0 ml) EtOH.
Mix by inverting tube 15-20 times and let sit for 10 minutes at room temperature.
Spin at 9,000 rpm (10,400 X g) for 6 min.

steps.title: DNA Resuspension and Transfer
steps.instruction: Prepare the DNA for final precipitation.

substeps.instruction: Pour off supernatant and let pellet drain well on paper towels.
Resuspend pellet in 400 μl of TE.
Spin down DNA in the centrifuge at top speed for three minutes to collect all liquid at the bottom.
Transfer the DNA solution to a 1.5 ml microfuge tube.

steps.title: Final DNA Precipitation
steps.instruction: Perform final precipitation in the microfuge tube.

substeps.instruction: Add 0.5 volume (200 μl) 7.5 M NH4OAc and 2 volumes (800 μl) EtOH.
Mix by inverting tube 15-20 times and let sit for 10 minutes at room temperature.
Spin at top speed in microfuge for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Drying and Storage
steps.instruction: Dry the pellet and store the final DNA.

substeps.instruction: Dry down pellet in vacuum chamber.
Resuspend in 50-500 µl TE.
Store in 4 degrees Celcius refrigerator overnight.
Quantify [DNA] on fluorometer.
Store at 4 degrees Celcius until ready to digest.
